selection.ownership: Calendly, LLC, Atlanta, Georgia, USA. Reviewed edition is the public international API at https://api.calendly.com, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official Calendly API v2 PAT Bearer auth (GET /users/me, GET /event_types, GET /event_types/{uuid}, GET /scheduled_events), Integrations API & Webhooks token page, Calendly LLC Atlanta identity, and dated incident search for Calendly security breach/incident reviewed on 2026-09-13. 2025-12 fake-invite phishing and 2026-04/06 hotel campaigns that abuse Calendly notification infrastructure or lookalike pages are not a Calendly API credential compromise. No qualifying current unresolved Calendly customer PAT/OAuth token compromise identified; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official Calendly API v2 at https://api.calendly.com authenticates with a personal access token or OAuth Bearer token. PAT is generated under Integrations > API & Webhooks and is not OAuth-only. Cheap authenticated read is GET /users/me. Dated 2026-09-13 incident search found phishing that impersonates or routes through Calendly email, not a documented compromise of api.calendly.com customer tokens. Not a breach-free claim.

incidents.affectedProduct: Calendly notification email (em1618.calendly.com) abused as a delivery channel

incidents.status: historical authentication-laundering abuse of Calendly send infrastructure; distinguished from API key compromise
incidents.remediation: Microsoft Threat Intelligence disclosure; not a documented api.calendly.com credential leak.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to official GET /users/me used by the pinned credential validator. Native uses PAT Bearer auth (not OAuth). Native category is scheduling rather than Productivity. Pinned user-agent is omitted.
Returns raw Calendly JSON under data instead of {currentUser: resource}.

Official GET /event_types requires organization or user. Native requires userUri (full user URI query value) rather than organization-only listing. Optional count, pageToken, and active map to count, page_token, and active. Returns raw Calendly JSON under data.
Official GET /event_types/{uuid}. Native takes eventTypeUuid as the path segment instead of extracting an id from a Calendly URI.

Official GET /scheduled_events requires organization or user. Native requires userUri. Optional count, pageToken, and status map to count, page_token, and status. Writes and invitee mutation are omitted.
